At temperature 0.25 on out-of-distribution CNN/DailyMail articles, **DPO gets a 0.31 GPT-4 win rate against the ground-truth summaries, and PPO gets 0.23** (Table 1, p. 9).

- The policies are the ones trained in the Reddit TL;DR summarization experiment. They were tested on news articles from the CNN/DailyMail test split, using the best TL;DR sampling temperatures, 0 and 0.25 (p. 9).
- GPT-4 judged with the same "GPT-4 (C)" prompt used for TL;DR, with "forum post" replaced by "news article" (p. 9).
- At temperature 0, the win rates were 0.36 for DPO and 0.26 for PPO (Table 1, p. 9).
- The authors say DPO "continues to outperform the PPO policy by a significant margin." They add that DPO did this without the extra unlabeled Reddit TL;DR prompts that PPO uses (p. 9).
